rules.coverage_note: Direct new Worker(...) from node:worker_threads is represented as a source-site Task declaration; scheduling/execution is not inferred.
Direct new MessageChannel(...) from node:worker_threads is represented as a source-site Resource declaration; messages/runtime endpoints are not inferred.
Direct new AsyncLocalStorage(...) from node:async_hooks is represented as a source-site RuntimeComponent declaration; async context values/runtime propagation are not inferred.
Generic provenance-backed authored framework API use; specialized framework semantics are added by dedicated rules.
Explicit resolved import/module provenance only; installation/runtime availability is not inferred.

gaps: runtime object identity, actual file/socket/process effects, event delivery and stream contents remain terminal runtime ceilings
CommonJS require/namespace/global API provenance is materialized only where host Pack resolves it to ExternalPath; unresolved dynamic require remains candidate evidence
filesystem paths/process command strings are not executed or normalized into real external resources unless authored static argument facts support a later safe rule
package-local application APIs are outside Node core overlay and remain generic JavaScript/TypeScript semantics
